svg.text: ESP8266 / ESP32 programmer · galvanic isolation · auto-reset + auto-boot · 3.3 V logic · top view
Connect to this pin on the ESP
The programmer drives RESET and BOOT itself:
esptool, Arduino IDE and ESP-IDF flash with no
button presses. By hand: hold BOOT, tap RESET,
Cap fitted = pull-up ON (to the isolated 3V3). JP1 =
RESET (EN), JP2 = BOOT (IO0). Ships with the caps
removed. Fit them for a bare module powered from
PC side and target side are galvanically isolated
(data and power), rated 1500 VDC. Keep the target's
GND separate from the PC's GND.
3.3 V logic. The isolated 3V3 pin can power the ESP
(up to about 150 mA). Cross TX/RX: programmer TX
to ESP RX. Always connect GND.
